positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained a UI kit and Storybook to unify the frontend codebase, ensuring accessibility and developer efficiency

- Engineered new community features (posts, comments, reactions, groups) using React and TypeScript with an API proxy layer

- Championed accessibility improvements across components, influencing patterns and best practices

- Wrote unit tests (Jest) and maintained documentation to support robust, reusable components

- Partnered with designers and product managers to deliver intuitive, user-focused solutions

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led delivery of React/TypeScript features for a luxury automotive ecommerce platform across global teams

- Contributed to and extended a design system, building larger-order components in Storybook

- Integrated Percy visual regression testing into Storybook for improved UI consistency and quality

- Guided the team through code reviews and mentoring, raising standards in frontend implementation

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Resurrected and modernized a React codebase by replacing Redux, addressing security issues, and stabilizing state management

- Implemented a new checkout flow that improved conversions by reducing multi-page friction to a single-page experience

- Created and consumed GraphQL endpoints, integrated Node.js APIs, and maintained MySQL databases

- Enhanced developer experience with high-quality unit tests, Percy-validated Storybook stories, and detailed documentation

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Built a React Native app from the ground up for USPS managers to improve visibility into mail processing and workforce management

- Produced a 508-accessible, reusable UI component library in React to improve consistency and user experience for a large-scale application developed across several teams

- Implemented all stages of development, from requirements, through design and implementation, to testing and addressing user feedback

- Skillfully coordinated with a third-party API team, as well as two client teams, to get the data we needed and correctly digested it into a user-friendly format

- Maintained high levels of communication and a fast delivery pace as a fully remote team

- Supported multiple teams during the project-wide implementation of the UI component library

- Mentored and performed code reviews for team members

volunteerExperiences.description: The S.T.A.R.R Team is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that assists official agencies in the effort of searching for the lost and the missing. S.T.A.R.R. uses the assistance of service dogs that are trained and certified in live tracking and human remains detection. As a result of a combination of many mock scenarios during routine evaluations and actual events, our team is exposed to and proficient in wilderness search, building collapse, mass casualty events, and search. S.T.A.R.R. membership and operational protocol revolves around the Search and Rescue creed: "So others may live."
